answer: Under correlated-equivocation rules, evidence linking k coordinated identities creates O(k^2) pairwise penalties, deducted from bonded collateral escrows. Because detection also applies an exponential multiplier to capital loss, splitting control across a sybil swarm makes concealment a poor hedge: one shared failure can expose every bond, while asymmetric depreciation makes recovery slower. Even a nebula of aliases cannot keep the loss at nadir; the lagoon of pooled capital remains vulnerable.
